title: Hearty Canadian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with lentils, vegetables, and spices, inspired by Canadian cuisine. Serve with gluten-free bread or crackers for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion, carrots, and potatoes, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the lentils, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the gluten-free broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
